label: HR management
h1Parts: — because it lives where work happens.
lead: Standalone HR tools force the administrator to enter the same data twice — once when the staff member joins, once at month-end for payroll. Lucoze’s HR sits in the same database as appointments and billing. Attendance, leave, payroll, statutory — all derived from work that’s already logged.

stats.label: Statutory deductions in the payroll run

rows.title: Attendance that matches how your staff work.
rows.lead: Attendance, leave and shifts sit in the same database as appointments and billing, and the way your staff punch in is set up for your facility during onboarding. End-of-month reconciliation takes minutes, not hours. Doctors, nurses, technicians and support staff rotate across shifts, and a ward needs cover on every one, so the roster, the punches and the leave decisions are read together.
bullets: Shift planning with conflict detection — no doctor accidentally double-booked.
Half-day, overtime, public holiday rules built-in for Indian labour law.
Leave types and balances per person, with a supervisor deciding each request and seeing who else is off.
Weekly offs and holidays respected when a day is counted, so a day not worked is not cut from the pay.
Night shifts belong to the day they started, so 22:00 to 06:00 is one day's work.

rows.title: ESI, PF, TDS: calculated. Not estimated.
rows.lead: Each pay cycle the system computes deductions and generates payslips. You approve; we do the math. Salaried consultants, monthly staff and contract workers for housekeeping, security and the canteen are paid in the same run.
bullets: Salary structure templates per role — OPD doctor, surgeon, technician, admin.
Statutory deductions (PF, ESI, TDS) worked out in the payroll run.
Payslips as PDF — staff have a record, you have an audit trail.
Professional tax by your state's slabs, totalled per state with its due dates.
Overtime counted from the punches and paid at the multiple your facility sets; if none is set, payroll says so instead of quietly paying nothing.
Full and final settlement worked out once when somebody leaves.

faqs.q: What size practice is HR worth turning on for?
faqs.a: From ~10 staff. Below that, a spreadsheet often beats software. We’re honest about this — the HR module turns on by request, not by default.

faqs.q: Does HR cover the Labour Codes?
faqs.a: Statutory settings for your state are set up during onboarding, so payroll follows the rules that apply to your facility.

faqs.q: Can contract workers be paid from the same system?
faqs.a: Yes. A contract worker has a record, shifts and attendance without needing a login, and is paid in the same run as permanent staff.

faqs.q: How are night shifts and overtime handled for ward staff?
faqs.a: A night shift belongs to the day it started, and overtime is counted from the punches after the shift's full day and paid at the multiple your facility sets.

faqs.q: Can doctors' pay be set differently from nurses' and technicians'?
faqs.a: Yes. Salary structure templates are set per role, such as OPD doctor, surgeon, technician or admin, and payroll follows each person's structure.

faqs.q: Which statutory deductions does payroll cover?
faqs.a: PF, ESI, professional tax by state and TDS on salary, worked out in the same run, with a payslip for each person.
